description: MCP server for SAP Cloud ALM (read-only by default)

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.Viewer
scopes.description: Read access to SAP Cloud ALM via calmcp

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.Writer
scopes.description: Create objects via calm_create and change features via calm_update (each needs its switch: CALM_WRITE_ENABLED, CALM_UPDATE_ENABLED)

role-templates.name: Viewer
role-templates.description: Read-only access to SAP Cloud ALM data

role-templates.name: Editor
role-templates.description: Read access plus calm_create and calm_update (only when the deployment enables them)

role-collections.name: CALMCP_Editor
role-collections.description: calmcp viewer that may also create objects and change features
